# 卡充值（仅适用储值卡）

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /rechargeCard:
    post:
      summary: 卡充值（仅适用储值卡）
      deprecated: false
      description: >-
        > 本页展示的是加密前的请求参数和解密后的返回数据。V1 实际请求需按《接入指南》用 VM 公钥加密后放入 `{"content":
        "密文"}`，返回的 `data` 需用商户私钥解密。
      tags:
        - VM卡操作 V1（仅限 2026-10-30 前已配置商户公钥的账户）
      parameters:
        - name: Authorization
          in: header
          description: ''
          example: '{{Authorization}}'
          schema:
            type: string
            default: '{{Authorization}}'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                card_id:
                  type: string
                  title: 卡ID
                  description: 后续将废弃，建议使用 vm_card_id；card_id 与 vm_card_id 至少传一个
                amount:
                  type: number
                  description: 充值金额，范围 10–50000，从账户 balance 扣除
                vm_card_id:
                  type: string
                  title: vm卡ID
                  description: VM 卡 ID（推荐使用）；card_id 与 vm_card_id 至少传一个
              x-apifox-orders:
                - card_id
                - vm_card_id
                - amount
              required:
                - amount
            example:
              vm_card_id: v4Qg*************HHSfg
              amount: 100
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                  msg:
                    type: string
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      data:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - data
                    x-apifox-orders:
                      - data
                required:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
                x-apifox-orders:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: VM卡操作 V1（仅限 2026-10-30 前已配置商户公钥的账户）
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/6388598/apis/api-295812049-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: https://sandbox-api.vmcardio.com
    description: API开发者
security: []

```
